releases.title: Verifiable evidence gates, ledger anchoring, signed reviews
highlights: Evidence gates G6 and G7 can now pass — only with REAL preregistered and unblinded data plus identity-verified sign-offs; replication must come from an independent identity and reviewer
Hourly external anchoring of the evidence ledger (off-site object store and public OpenTimestamps calendars): deleting recent entries is now detectable
Sign-offs, preregistrations, unblinding and dataset ingestion record the identity bound to the access token, never a typed name
Retention policy: old job results are removed after 30 days unless referenced by the evidence ledger

releases.title: Typeset equations, reliable Reset and playback, security audit
highlights: Every equation is now typeset in LaTeX (KaTeX), with a 'Governing equations' card on each suite
Reset returns a suite exactly to its first-visit state: inputs, outputs, animations and caches
Every animation visibly plays from t = 0 and loops, with an honest 'below display resolution' notice and labelled magnified view where changes are tiny
Readable 3-D views: brighter cyclic phase colours, in-canvas legends, auto-fit camera
Decoherence suite shows established mechanisms by default; collapse models are opt-in and labelled hypothetical
CSL collapse added as the 8th competing hypothesis; new dossier limits for electric dipoles, magnetic field and Stern–Gerlach precision
fixes: Clear messages instead of raw error codes; computations are open to everyone, evidence writes need a token
Comprehensive audit: evidence-ledger concurrency, blind-data protection, input validation, abuse limits, backup consistency, unequal-mass and collapse-model physics
Accessibility: zero automated violations across all pages; mobile layouts fixed

releases.title: Reset controls, more 3-D simulations, Aziz–Howl model
highlights: Reset button beside every Run: restore defaults and clear previous results before running
New animated 3-D views for optomechanics, decoherence, EM backgrounds, measurement, inference, design and discovery
Two more competing hypotheses: Aziz–Howl classical-gravity + quantum-matter mechanism and CSL collapse (8 in total)
Faster job handling: a fast lane so short jobs never wait behind long studies
Lean 4: 43 machine-checked theorems — the dephasing threshold is now exact: separable for all time iff Γ ≥ |dΔφ/dt|/2
New dossier requirements: electric-dipole limit, magnetic-field limit during interaction, Stern–Gerlach gradient precision
Suites listed in order 1–18 and a 'What's new' pop-up after every update
fixes: Thought-experiment results now include environmental decoherence and Casimir forces
Clear warnings when residual charge makes entanglement measures meaningless
Stricter input validation for interferometry and optomechanics

releases.title: First public release
highlights: 18 scientific suites with the gravity-mediated entanglement flagship study
Six competing hypotheses with nuisance-robust model discrimination
Experimental dossiers, thought-experiment laboratory, evidence ledger and seven acceptance gates
